title: Write-behind flush requires millisecond conversion AND audit event
description: The schedule_flush function must convert interval_seconds to milliseconds before calling _start_timer AND write a cache.flush.completed audit event via orgops.auditing.write_event for compliance tracking.
code:
# Write-Behind Flush Scheduling — Two Requirements

## 1. Convert Seconds to Milliseconds
`_start_timer` expects milliseconds, not seconds:
```python
interval_ms = interval_seconds * 1000
_start_timer(interval_ms, callback=flush_fn)
```

## 2. Audit Event Emission (REQUIRED)
```python
import orgops.auditing
orgops.auditing.write_event("cache.flush.completed", items_flushed=len(buffer))
```
